## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Sep 12, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Andrew Wiens_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "Evernote used to be a great, free note-taking app. Now, it's almost unusable. Slowwww and laggy. Takes me 4x as long as it should to type anything, tapping my fingers waiting for letters to appear. Also forced to watch the same video ad every time I open a note. Limit the # of notes (50 last I checked but might be fewer now--if not, that "update" is coming soon). They also limit the # of devices you can use the app on w/same account to... 1. Exporting notes sucks. This app is not good 👎👎👎"
            2. _Kyle Lockwood_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "Holy cow this app is so unusable now, they bombard you with their own ads asking you to pay. I saw 3 30 second ads before I was able to open up a note I had saved years ago Never have I seen an app fall this hard. Run away and find another note app."
            3. _A Google user_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "I had been using this app since 2013. Since then the software has become bloated with features I don't need or want, and popups you have to click through every time you open the app to tell you about them. After 13 years with this app, the cumbersome glitchy nature of the app combined with a jaw-dropping price increase was enough to make me quit the platform and find something else."
